Failed Ignition System.description: Clicking or grinding on startup. The ignition switch or starter motor has failed. Vehicle cannot be driven. Requires immediate repair.

Dead or Weak Battery.urgency_label: 🟠 High — Jump start or replace battery
Dead or Weak Battery.description: Slow cranking or single click on startup. Battery charge is critically low. May also indicate a faulty alternator not charging the battery properly.

Low Engine Oil Level.urgency_label: 🟠 High — Top up engine oil immediately
Low Engine Oil Level.description: Ticking or rattling from the engine indicates critically low or dirty oil. Continued driving without oil will permanently damage engine components.

Low Oil + Serpentine Belt Fault.description: Combined ticking (low oil) and squealing (serpentine belt) detected. Both faults require immediate attention. Check oil level and inspect drive belt.

Normal Brake Operation.description: Brakes are functioning normally. No abnormal sounds detected.

Normal Engine Idle.description: Engine is idling smoothly. No fault detected.

Normal Engine Startup.description: Engine cranks and starts normally. No fault detected.

Power Steering Pump Fault + Low Oil.description: Whining from power steering pump combined with engine ticking from low oil. Check power steering fluid and engine oil levels. Steering may become stiff.

Power Steering + Low Oil + Serpentine Be.part: Power Steering / Oil System / Drive Belt
Power Steering + Low Oil + Serpentine Be.description: Three concurrent faults detected: power steering pump whine, low engine oil ticking, and serpentine belt squealing. Do not drive. Requires full inspection.

Power Steering Pump + Serpentine Belt Fa.description: Whining from power steering combined with serpentine belt squealing. The serpentine belt drives the power steering pump — a worn belt may be causing both issues.

Power Steering Pump Fault.urgency_label: 🟡 Medium — Repair within a few days
Power Steering Pump Fault.description: Whining or groaning from the power steering pump when turning. Likely low power steering fluid or a failing pump. Steering effort will increase progressively.

Worn or Loose Serpentine Belt.description: Squealing or chirping from the serpentine belt. A failing belt can snap suddenly, disabling the alternator, power steering, AC and water pump simultaneously.

Worn Brake Pads \u2014 Metal-on-Metal Co.description: Grinding or squealing from worn brake pads. Metal-on-metal contact is occurring. Braking distance is severely compromised. Do not drive until brake pads are replaced.
